Tiny Core on Alter/Linux

This desktop uses the original Tiny Core X11 applications.

The dock contains Terminal, Files, Editor, Images, Paint, Calculator,
Tiny Core information and Exit desktop. Click the blue desktop for the complete
application menu, including the Flit clock.

Your folders:
  /root/Documents    Notes and text files
  /root/Pictures     Images and drawings
  /root/Downloads    Downloaded files

Files saved in this bundle survive desktop Exit. A QEMU smoke test instead uses
a temporary disk snapshot. Exit desktop stops the container, not Nanami.
